topics: Introduction to Natural Language Processing - Various stages of traditional NLP – Challenges
Naive Bayes for Text Classification, and Sentiment Analysis
Evaluation-Precision, Recall and F-measure-Test sets and cross validation
Context-Free Grammars, Constituency Parsing, Ambiguity, CYK Parsing
Dependency Parsing - Transition-Based Dependency Parsing, Graph-Based Dependency Parsing, Evaluation
Lexical Semantics, Vector Semantics, TF-IDF, Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI)
Neural Word embeddings - Word2vec, GloVe, Contextual Word Embeddings
Feedforward Neural Networks for Text Classification

Sequence Modelling - Recurrent Neural Networks, RNNs as Language Models, RNNs for NLP tasks, Stacked and Bidirectional RNN architectures, Recursive Neural Networks, LSTM & GRU, Common RNN NLP Architectures
Encoder-Decoder Model with RNNs, Attention models, Transformers
NLP Applications - Machine Translation, Question Answering and Information Retrieval

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 subdivisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Understand the foundational concepts of NLP and apply that to do text processing.
Utilize word representations and evaluate vector models for NLP
Analyse and implement advanced linguistic annotation and parsing techniques
Apply advanced sequence modeling techniques using Neural Networks
Apply NLP techniques in machine translation, question answering, and information ret rieval.
